scope: Historical start-only draft; it now refuses --launch and must not be used. Full draft with inspect/recreate/cleanup is lifecycle_source_proposal.py.

planned_mechanism.enrollment: Use already-existing Host config registration token read only under exact ROOT/private/config guards; derive config with fresh unique node_name, omit agent_id/node_ip. Valid first HELLO with RegistrationKey and empty AgentID creates a Node with new generated AgentID/credential; HELLO_ACK returns it and Agent persists all identity fields in the new DataDir.
planned_mechanism.secret_transport: Registration token is read in memory from original root-owned 0600 config, copied only into a new 65534:65534 0600 config beneath a 65534:65534 0700 private directory, mounted RO. It is never in source literal, Task parameter, shell env, stdout, evidence, or Hub Admin response. No Admin enrollment POST is used.
planned_mechanism.host_objects: One new owned bind root with private/data subdirectories, one bridge network, one container A. No separate Docker volume or initializer container. No edits to original Host root/config, image, Unit or policy.
planned_mechanism.network: Use new bridge with dynamic Docker-assigned IP and report only the selected address.
planned_mechanism.container: Pinned image, UID/GID65534, cap-drop ALL, read-only rootfs, no-new-privileges, default seccomp, private PID/network, only config RO + DataDir RW binds, optional 16MiB private tmpfs /tmp; no host mounts/devices/ports.
planned_mechanism.gating: The source requires a 64-hex shell SHA argument and verifies it against the exact guarded tar before any root/resource creation. Measured member SHA is a6f559e00b69a4aa4d8cb607be18d9386c5aee55c509e2c075549dcf00e00fc7; old proposal pin a6f559e00b69a4aa9d8cb607be18d9386c5aee55c509e2c075549dcf00e00fc7 differs by one nibble. The exact proposed bridge was absent in the reviewed read-only probe; recheck immediately before create. Root must review the measured hash and confirm unique NodeName via Admin GET.
